Attached is the finalized penetration test report from our assessment on your Redwood-hosted tenant. TL;DR: We own this and will deliver a staged remediation + evidence bundle. High-level plan below with owners and ETAs. We'll share an evidence drive link when we have the first artifacts (rotation proof + sanitized access logs).

Immediate actions (24h):
- Rotate all suspected service tokens and revoke any long-lived keys (Owner: Dev Patel) — ETA: 2026-10-04 23:59 PDT. Evidence: token rotation audit (audit_id SEC-1187), rotation command logs.
- Disable /internal/debug/* endpoints in hosted routing config (Owner: Irene Choi) — ETA: 2026-10-05 12:00 PDT. Evidence: nginx config diff + deploy PR.
- Add request-level denylist and 401 enforcement for unauthorized access to internal routes (Owner: Naomi Feldman) — ETA: 2026-10-05 18:00 PDT. Evidence: service policy snapshot + integration test run.

Follow-up actions (48–96h):
- Backfill redaction and token-hash logging for historical requests, provide sanitized CSV of hits with timestamps (Owner: Dev Patel) — ETA: 2026-10-06 17:00 PDT. Evidence: access-log-excerpt-20261003.csv (sanitized).
- Post-deploy pen test re-validation with Miro or equivalent (Coordination: Security) — ETA: scheduler by 2026-10-07.
- Add long-term control: short-lived ephemeral tokens + automatic rotation policy (Owner: Irene Choi) — ETA: 2026-10-20 (roadmap item).

Requested artifacts we will provide in the shared drive:
1) Rotation proof: audit trail showing revoke + new token issuance (signed commit + commands).
2) Deploy PRs and config diffs that remove/guard the debug endpoint.
3) Sanitized access logs showing blocked attempts and no exfil attempts after rotation.
4) Post-remediation test notes and retest engagement plan.

Links we'll populate: https://reddrive.redwood.ai/shared/Acme-pt-evidence, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4721, JIRA: SEC-1187.

If Acme needs a more formal artifacts checklist for SOC2 upload, let me know and we'll map our artifacts to their template (e.g., CAIQ evidence fields).

I'll run daily check-ins here until the evidence bundle is complete.
